Author:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
AuthorDate: Tue Apr 22 22:15:02 2025 +0000
Commit:     Corey Bryant <corey@thunderbird.net>
CommitDate: Tue Apr 22 22:15:02 2025 +0000

    Bug 1961863 - Add crashhelper to hardened-sign-config and default globs. r=dandarnell
    
    Differential Revision: https://phabricator.services.mozilla.com/D246327

diff --git a/taskcluster/config.yml b/taskcluster/config.yml
index 14e2086c6eb..698b5b67c3c 100644
--- a/taskcluster/config.yml
+++ b/taskcluster/config.yml
@@ -380,6 +380,7 @@ mac-signing:
                   force: true
                   # These files are signed without entitlements
                   globs:
+                      - "/Contents/MacOS/crashhelper"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/crashreporter.app"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/updater.app/Contents/Frameworks/UpdateSettings.framework"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/updater.app"
@@ -419,6 +420,7 @@ mac-signing:
                   force: true
                   entitlements: comm/build/macosx/hardenedruntime/v2/developer/utility.xml
                   globs:
+                      - "/Contents/MacOS/crashhelper"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/crashreporter.app"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/updater.app/Contents/Frameworks/UpdateSettings.framework"
                       - "/Contents/MacOS/updater.app"
title: Bug 1961863 - Add crashhelper to hardened-sign-config and default globs. r=dandarnell
